pacific-great-eastern-railway.note: BC Archives GR-0876: general Railway Department correspondence files of the PGE, 1919-1951. OIC 683/1926 appointed the PGE board on the Minister of Railways' recommendation and OIC 529/1926 calls the Minister of Railways "President of the Pacific Great Eastern Railway Co." (1919); OIC 644/1932 (director resignation) also from Railways. BC Archives GR-4387 notes that Premiers Tolmie and Pattullo were also Minister of Railways and PGE president.

OICs on the PGE board, pension rules and construction loans were recommended by the Minister of Finance: 1210/1947, 2382/1957, 3818/1971. OIC 2380/1957 is signed "Minister of Finance and as President of Pacific Great Eastern Railway". This is shareholder/financing evidence; railway-safety OICs (Railway Act) came from the Railway Department and later the Department of Commercial Transport.

gaps: pacific-great-eastern-railway: 1918, and 1952-1972. After 1947, OICs show only Finance (shareholder/financing) and Commercial Transport (Railway Act regulation); no source names a responsible minister for W.A.C. Bennett-era governance beyond the Premier/Minister of Finance.
liquor-control-board: covered only by the recommending minister on OICs; no statute-assignment OIC was found.
bc-ferry-authority: 1966-1968 not established. The 1968 Vesting Act moved the undertaking to the Crown; the Highways link rests on a single 1968 OIC plus the 1973 BC Archives note.
bc-hydro: 1962-1964 not found (1962-64 OICs name only the Minister of Finance as fiscal agent). 1976 and Apr-Nov 1991 not established.
agricultural-land-commission: 1996-1998 and 2000-2001 (Land Reserve Commission era) not established.
provincial-capital-commission: 1996-1998 and 1999-2000 not established. The 1996 Health/IGR end date is unknown.
bc-film-commission: 1978-1986 and 1988-2002 not established beyond the 1978 founding minister and the 1988 transfer.
bc-enterprise-corporation: early 1987 is shown only by Finance financing OICs; no statute assignment was found before July 1988.
industry-training-and-apprenticeship-commission: late 2001 to 2003 wind-up is ambiguous (the Act was listed under both Advanced Education and Skills Development and Labour).
tourism-bc: no gap; the 1997 start rests on the 1997 statute list.
bc-council-for-international-education: before 2013 (when it was a society, from 1990) not found.
innovate-bc: the 2018 start is year-level only.
Service-plan periods are bounded by the plan years. Where a date appears, it comes from the reorganization OIC or the LLBC cabinet change date for the named ministry.
